contenido:
Based in Buenos Aires, Argentina, South America, yet shaped by an international culture, streetwear is our canvas—an excuse to design, create, and represent a lifestyle, a culture without borders.

Mantra: "Be strong to move the world" The famous phrase attributed to Archimedes—"Give me a lever long enough and a fulcrum on which to place it, and I shall move the world"—has been the cornerstone of Western thought on efficiency and the power of strategy.
At Graund Dsgn, we take this principle beyond mechanical physics into the realm of personal and creative growth. To move the outside world, you must first build an unbreakable strength within. Resilience, consistency, and a clear purpose act as the essential components of that lever.
Every garment and every design we create seeks to remind you that you possess the necessary tools to generate a monumental impact on your environment. We create graphics for those who forge their own path. Each collection represents a different way of facing the world, but they all stem from the same idea: strength is not just physical; it is the ability to move, create, question, and leave a mark.
Above all, we want to have fun doing it, striving to always deliver a fresh product that we want to wear ourselves, hoping that those who acquire our garments feel the exact same way.

extracto: Graund Design Co. is not a clothing store (even if our social media says otherwise, lol); it is a creative design studio that bridges apparel and urban culture. The brand stems from the premise that true strength does not stem from external imposition, but rather from internal construction ("inner strength").
contenido:
Graund Design Co. is not a clothing store (even if our social media says otherwise, lol); it is a creative design studio that bridges apparel and urban culture. The brand stems from the premise that true strength does not stem from external imposition, but rather from internal construction ("inner strength").
GRAUND Manifesto Cultivating Inner Strength To change the world, power must be built from within. True strength is not just about brute force; it is a combination of resilience, clarity, and unwavering purpose.
Resilience: The capacity to adapt and be flexible in the face of a changing environment.
Focus: Directing your energy toward a single point of significant impact rather than scattering your efforts. Consistency goes a long way, transforming small steps into great paths.
Consistency: Applying steady, daily pressure that, over time, translates into a transcendental shift.
How to Apply Your Strength? When you are ready to make an impact, remember these fundamental principles:
Find your fulcrum: Identify your core values, your unique strengths, or the exact turning point in your situation where minimum effort produces maximum results.
Develop your lever: Equip yourself with the knowledge, skills, and people who form your proper support network to enhance your natural capabilities.
Take action: Stand firm and trust the momentum you generate.
Positioning: Designer identity geared toward independent spirits and creators.

Skull & Bulls (White & Negative): A dual series with high visual contrast. The White version prioritizes clean lines and minimalist strength; the Negative version explores the sharpness of negative space and a more underground aesthetic. Two versions. The same attitude.
Strength has two sides: -White: represents clarity, determination, and control. -Negative: showcases the darker, rebellious, and unpredictable side.
The White version displays strength in its purest form. Defined lines, character, and a clean aesthetic that conveys confidence without exaggeration. A design created for those who make the balance between simplicity and attitude a way of life.
The Negative version reveals the other side of the same story. More intense, darker, and provocative. It plays with negative spaces to create a different visual identity, ideal for those who find beauty in contrast and do not follow conventional paths.
It is not about choosing a design. It is about choosing how you want to face the world. Choose your side.

Power Gym: Aimed at discipline, strength training, and physical rigor without artifice. Strength is not shown, it is built. Power Gym is inspired by those who train with discipline, consistency, and determination. No poses or empty promises: just work, effort, and the satisfaction of overcoming your own limits every single day. Strength cannot be bought. It is built.
Power Gym was born for those who understand that every workout is a conversation with oneself. No excuses. No shortcuts. Just discipline, consistency, and evolution. Your true rival is always yourself. Built by effort.

extracto: NON Originalis: A designer line focused on an ironic critique of fashion cloning and hyper-production. We live surrounded by "original" copies resulting from the scarcity of things being so on-demand. NON Originalis was born as a critique, with a touch of acid humor. It is a collection for those who value original ideas, independence, and creativity as a form of expression. Don't be "original"—be yourself, and don't forget the humor.

A collection for those who believe every surface can become a canvas and every design a statement. The streets speak. No More Stickers is inspired by the visual language of urban art, where a simple graphic can transform a wall, a bicycle, or a laptop into a statement of identity. Every design is a mark.
